title: Nico the Little Reindeer’s Snowy Day
subtitle: A Bold & Easy Color & Read Story Book for Kids Ages 3-6
hook: The stocking stuffer that isn’t candy.
summary: Snow angels, sledding and a snowman with Tilly the penguin.
story: It’s a snowy morning, and Nico can’t wait to play outside. He makes a snow angel, meets his new friend Tilly the penguin, zooms down a hill on a red sled, builds a snowman, slides across the frozen pond, and cozies up with Mama for hot cocoa by the fire.
highlights: 29 full-page winter pictures that tell one sweet story
Bold, thick lines that are easy to color
One short sentence in big, clear letters on every page
A “This book belongs to” page for gifting
cover_alt: Cover of Nico the Little Reindeer’s Snowy Day: Nico and Tilly the penguin ride a sled past a snowman

inside.text: Whee! They zoom down the big hill.
Now they build a snowman together.
Nico catches a snowflake on his tongue.
Nico and Mama sip cocoa by the fire.

colored.text: They roll a big, round snowball.
Nico gives the snowman his red scarf.
